The discussion of the interpretation of the saying of the Exalted, Whose names are sanctified: ﴿By time (al-'asr) (1) Indeed, mankind is in loss (2) except those who believe, do righteous deeds, advise one another to the truth, and advise one another to patience (3)﴾.

The people of interpretation (ahl al-ta'wil) differed over the interpretation of His saying: ﴿By time (al-'asr)﴾. Some said: It is an oath that our Lord, mighty be His mention, swore by time (al-dahr), so He said: al-'asr is al-dahr.

Mention of those who said this:

⁕ 'Ali narrated to me, saying: Abu Salih narrated to us, saying: Mu'awiya narrated to me, from 'Ali, from Ibn 'Abbas, regarding His saying: ﴿By time (al-'asr)﴾, he said: Al-'asr is an hour of the hours of the day.

⁕ Ibn 'Abd al-A'la narrated to us, saying: Ibn Thawr narrated to us, from Ma'mar, from al-Hasan: ﴿By time (al-'asr)﴾, he said: It is the late afternoon (al-'ashiyy).

The correct view on this is to say: Our Lord swore by al-'asr. ﴿Al-'asr﴾ is a name for time (al-dahr), and it is the late afternoon, the night and the day. He did not single out one meaning over another from what this name encompasses, so everything to which this name applies is included in what He, majestic be His praise, swore by.

* *

And His saying: ﴿Indeed, mankind is in loss﴾

He says: The son of Adam is in ruin and diminishment.

'Ali, may God be pleased with him, used to recite it: ﴿Indeed, mankind is in loss, and indeed he will be in it until the end of time﴾.

⁕ Ibn 'Abd al-A'la ibn Wasil narrated to me, saying: Abu Nu'aym al-Fadl ibn Dukayn narrated to us, saying: Isra'il informed us, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Amr Dhu Murr, who said: I heard 'Ali, may God be pleased with him, recite this verse: ﴿By time (al-'asr) and the misfortunes of time, indeed mankind is in loss, and indeed he will be in it until the end of time﴾.

⁕ Bishr narrated to us, saying: Yazid narrated to us, saying: Sa'id narrated to us, from Qatada: (Indeed, mankind is in loss). In some recitations: ﴿and indeed he will be in it until the end of time﴾.

⁕ Abu Kurayb narrated to us, saying: Waki' narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Abu Ishaq, from 'Amr Dhu Murr, that 'Ali, may God be pleased with him, recited it: ﴿By time (al-'asr) and the misfortunes of time, indeed mankind is in loss﴾.

⁕ Muhammad ibn 'Amr narrated to me, saying: Abu 'Asim narrated to us, saying: 'Isa narrated to us; and al-Harith narrated to me, saying: al-Hasan narrated to us, saying: Warqa' narrated to us, both together from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid: ﴿Indeed, mankind is in loss﴾ except the one who believes: ﴿except those who believe and do righteous deeds﴾. He says: Except those who believed God and affirmed His oneness, acknowledged His unity and obedience to Him, did righteous deeds, fulfilled what was obligatory upon them of His commands, and avoided the acts of disobedience He forbade them. He excepted those who believe from mankind (al-insan) because al-insan carries the sense of a plural, not of a single person.

* *

And His saying: ﴿and advise one another to the truth﴾

He says: And they enjoined one another to adhere to acting upon what God revealed in His Book of His commands, and to avoid what He forbade in it.

The people of interpretation said something similar to what we have said on this.

Mention of those who said this:

⁕ Bishr narrated to us, saying: Yazid narrated to us, saying: Sa'id narrated to us, from Qatada: ﴿and advise one another to the truth﴾, and the truth is the Book of God.

⁕ Ibn 'Abd al-A'la narrated to us, saying: Ibn Thawr narrated to us, from Ma'mar, from al-Hasan: ﴿and advise one another to the truth﴾, he said: The truth is the Book of God.

⁕ 'Imran ibn Bakkar al-Kala'i narrated to me, saying: Khattab ibn 'Uthman narrated to us, saying: 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Sinan Abu Rawh al-Saksaki narrated to us, a man of Hims whom I met in Armenia, saying: I heard al-Hasan say regarding ﴿and advise one another to the truth﴾: The truth is the Book of God.

* *

And His saying: ﴿and advise one another to patience﴾

He says: And they enjoined one another to patience in acting in obedience to God.

The people of interpretation said something similar to what we have said on this.

Mention of those who said this:

⁕ Bishr narrated to us, saying: Yazid narrated to us, saying: Sa'id narrated to us, from Qatada: ﴿and advise one another to patience﴾, he said: Patience is obedience to God.

⁕ 'Imran ibn Bakkar al-Kala'i narrated to me, saying: Khattab ibn 'Uthman narrated to us, saying: 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Sinan Abu Rawh narrated to us, saying: I heard al-Hasan say regarding His saying: ﴿and advise one another to patience﴾, he said: Patience is obedience to God.

⁕ Ibn 'Abd al-A'la narrated to us, saying: Ibn Thawr narrated to us, from Ma'mar, from al-Hasan: ﴿and advise one another to patience﴾, he said: Patience is obedience to God.

End of the tafsir of Surat al-'Asr.
